messages:
Cassie Liu: Hi team — kickoff for Aventa Health onboarding. Goal: pilot live in 30 days, capture renewal risk flags early, and set a lightweight feedback loop. Quick owners? :wave:
Diego Ramirez: I'll own API integration + sample payload validation. Plan a smoke-run by day 4 and will post request/response examples.
Hannah Cole: I'll lead enablement + playbook. Propose 2 x 40m sessions (integration + prompts/evals). Target wk1 and wk2.
Marcus Green: Data & compliance here. Need their sample payloads, DPA, and SOC2. If we see PHI-like fields we'll require a minimization/redaction plan.
Cassie Liu: Sent intro + SOC2/DPA request earlier today. Will escalate to their security lead if no reply by EOD tomorrow. Exec sponsor is currently unknown  we should secure an intro before week 2.
Diego Ramirez: Infra suggestion: start on a small Dedicated pool, batch size 6, prefix cache on. That should be predictable for p95 latency while we validate.
Hannah Cole: Enablement checklist v0:
- Day 0: stakeholder intros + roles
- Day 3: API integration walkthrough
- Day 7: prompt design & 10-case eval
- Day 12: failover & monitoring runbook
- Day 30: pilot review + renewal conversation
I'll upload slides after session 1.
Marcus Green: Data risks: potential sensitive fields; I'll draft redaction rules and KMS access notes in 48h. Also logging retention options.
Cassie Liu: Proposed success criteria: 1) three core flows pass end-to-end, 2) p95 latency < 350ms, 3) error rate < 1% and spend within pilot cap. Thoughts?
Diego Ramirez: Agree. Add an ops alert if projected spend > 125% of the cap. I'll add that to the ticket.
Hannah Cole: We'll run a pre/post prompt regression (10 cases) and publish results to the shared doc. I'll own the eval set.
OnboardBot: Calendar invite created: "Aventa Health - Onboarding Huddle" scheduled 2025-10-20 11:00 PDT (invite sent).
Cassie Liu: Action items recap:
- Cassie: chase exec intro + SOC2/DPA (today)
- Diego: smoke-run + sample request/response examples (day 4)
- Hannah: publish enablement schedule + eval set (wk1)
- Marcus: redaction plan + KMS notes (48h)
If anything blocks, post here and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
